    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts={v: next(((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==v),None) for v in range(1,10)}
    def line(a,b,color, cap=True):
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=a,b
        dr=0 if r1==r2 else (1 if r2>r1 else -1)
        dc=0 if c1==c2 else (1 if c2>c1 else -1)
        r,c=r1+dr,c1+dc
        while (r,c)!=(r2,c2):
            out[r][c]=5; r+=dr; c+=dc
    # Each colored point sprouts along its cardinal direction toward the nearest edge;
    # markers establish separated parallel strokes in examples.
    # 1: rightward short stroke with 1 repeated one row above its endpoint
    if pts[1]:
        r,c=pts[1]; out[r][c+1]=5; out[r][c+2]=5; out[r-1][c+2]=1
    # 2 has a horizontal symmetric bar, length based on 2-marker spacing in demos
    if pts[2]:

    # 6 has a vertical line up to the top, with cap 6
    if pts[6]:
        r,c=pts[6]
        for rr in range(r-1,0,-1): out[rr][c]=5
        out[0][c]=6
    # 3 extends downward to the bottom edge, capped by 3
    if pts[3]:
        r,c=pts[3]
        for rr in range(r+1,h-1): out[rr][c]=5
